articles.title: After 241 Days in Space, an Astronaut Finally Comes Home!
articles.summary: Imagine circling Earth 3,856 times! NASA astronaut Chris Williams just did that and more during his 241-day space mission. He landed safely in Kazakhstan on July 26, 2026.

articles.title: Could a Loaf of Bread Be a Sign of Alien Life?
articles.summary: Scientists usually look for alien tech or tiny microbes. But what if something as simple as bread shows intelligence? A researcher says bread needs many steps to make—so finding it on another planet could mean someone smart baked it!

articles.title: A 500,000-Year-Old Elephant Bone Hammer Shows Ancient Humans Were Super Smart
articles.summary: Archaeologists found a hammer made from an elephant bone in England. It's 500,000 years old! Early humans used it to sharpen stone tools, proving they were clever and resourceful.
